Grid displays applications filtered per selections.
Grid row includes links to details, email, status, and withdrawn date.

Panels for errors and warnings are updated based on system/process events.
JavaScript setup for handling UI variable declarations and async post-backs.
exceptions: Invalid date input triggers error messages.
Empty data triggers visible labels and actions for adding new records.

system_behavior: Assessment grid updates, popups for add/edit, validation on data entry, error reporting, and role-dependent permissions.
exceptions: Validation errors: interim without final, instructor/supervisor conflicts, assessment maximum exceeded.
